verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML screening and transaction-monitoring platform, so custom allow/block lists and velocity limits are a fair question for it. The evidence only covers selecting sanctions/PEP screening lists, configuring risk-score equations, and per-customer monitoring settings. These are adjacent controls; nothing documents user-maintained allow/block lists of emails, cards, devices or IPs, or velocity limits, in either the dashboard or the API.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can maintain allow and block lists — emails, cards, devices, IPs — and velocity limits, managed through the dashboard and programmatically
